text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Customs (Fuel Tank — Prescribed Places) Regulations.

2. For the purposes of section 136(2)(a) of the Act, the following places shall each be a prescribed place:
(a)Woodlands;
(b)[Deleted by S 637/2021 wef 01/09/2021]
(c)Tuas.
[G.N. No. S 145/2003]
